name: x1 lot from high to low
summary: This EA opens a fixed 1-lot sell position when price moves from high to low, acting as a simple trend-following or momentum entry system. The companion EA (low to high) opens buys in the opposite direction. Both use a fixed lot size with no dynamic position sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA在价格从高向低运动时开设1手固定手数的卖出仓位，作为简单的趋势跟踪或动量入场系统。配套EA（从低到高）在相反方向开设买入仓位。两者均使用固定手数，无动态仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于价格动量方向进行简单入场，当检测到价格从高位向低位运动时开立卖出仓位。入场条件可能是基于价格比较（如当前价低于前一根K线高点或前几根K线高点）来判断下行趋势启动。出场条件从命名来看缺乏明确的止盈止损逻辑，可能依赖手动关闭或简单的追踪止损。仓位管理采用固定1手手数，没有任何基于账户余额或风险比例的动态调整。资金管理方面完全缺失，没有考虑账户净值、最大回撤或风险敞口控制。整体来看这是一个非常原始的趋势入场工具，缺乏完整的风险管理体系。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a simple momentum-directional entry that opens a sell position when price is detected moving from high to low. Entry conditions likely rely on price comparisons such as current price dropping below a prior candle high or a series of declining highs to signal downside momentum initiation. Exit conditions appear absent from the naming convention, with no explicit take-profit or stop-loss logic, potentially relying on manual closure or simple trailing stops. Position sizing is fixed at 1 lot with no dynamic adjustment based on account balance, equity, or risk percentage. Money management is entirely absent, with no consideration for account drawdown limits, risk exposure control, or equity-based lot scaling. Overall this is a very primitive trend entry tool lacking a complete risk management framework.
pros: 策略逻辑极其简单，易于理解和验证
固定手数消除了仓位计算错误的风险
两个互补EA可以灵活组合使用
pros_en: Strategy logic is extremely simple and easy to understand and verify
Fixed lot size eliminates risk of position sizing calculation errors
Two complementary EAs can be flexibly combined for different market views
cons: 固定1手手数不考虑账户规模，小账户风险极大
缺乏明确的止损止盈逻辑，可能导致无限亏损
没有新K线检查，可能在同一根K线重复开仓
没有持仓检查，可能无限加仓
缺乏资金管理和风险控制机制
cons_en: Fixed 1 lot size ignores account size, posing extreme risk for small accounts
Lack of explicit stop-loss and take-profit logic may result in unlimited losses
No new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same candle
No position check may lead to unlimited position accumulation
Absence of money management and risk control mechanisms
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，默认设置合理的风险回报比
实现基于账户余额的动态手数计算，替代固定1手
添加持仓检查和新K线检查防止重复开仓
improvements_en: Add stop-loss and take-profit parameters with default risk-reward ratios
Implement dynamic lot sizing based on account balance instead of fixed 1 lot
Add position check and new bar check to prevent repeated entries on same candle

risk_points: 固定1手手数对任何账户都可能造成过大风险敞口
缺乏止损机制可能导致单笔交易无限亏损
没有持仓检查可能无限加仓导致爆仓
risk_points_en: Fixed 1 lot size may create excessive risk exposure for any account size
Lack of stop-loss mechanism may result in unlimited loss per trade
No position check may allow unlimited position accumulation leading to margin call

summary_en: This EA opens a fixed 1-lot sell position when price moves from high to low, acting as a simple trend-following or momentum entry system. The companion EA (low to high) opens buys in the opposite direction. Both use a fixed lot size with no dynamic position sizing.
